_comment: Merge into the adopting repo's .claude/settings.json. Paths assume the hook scripts land in .claude/hooks/. Two hooks read a data file that must land beside them: pii-guard.sh reads pii-patterns.json (missing ⇒ DENY, fail closed) and shariah-term-guard.sh reads shariah-surfaces.txt (missing or empty ⇒ NO-OP, because an empty scope list means no declared Islamic surfaces, which is the correct default for most adopters). Every hook here exits 0 and expresses refusal as a deny DECISION — a non-zero exit is a non-blocking error in Claude Code, i.e. a silent disarm.
